name: Extra Frames
description: Adds input buffering and coyote time for cube jumps, with keybinds and an in-game menu.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer window (ticks)
buffer-ticks.description: Clicks made this many physics ticks before landing still register. GD runs at 240 ticks/sec, so 4 ticks is about 16.7ms.

coyote-ticks.name: Coyote window (ticks)
coyote-ticks.description: Clicks made this many ticks after walking off a ledge still jump.

toggle-key.name: Toggle Extra Frames
toggle-key.description: Turn input buffering and coyote time on or off.
